log_level.description: Verbosity of logging; choose from debug, info, warning, error

pid_file.description: Path to store the daemon's PID file

auto_detect.description: Enable automatic detection and monitoring of newly connected battery devices

notification_script.description: Path to script invoked on battery status changes (receives device name, status, and % capacity)

tick_interval.description: Number of seconds between battery status polls

warning_threshold.description: Battery percentage at or below which a 'warning' alert is triggered

critical_threshold.description: Battery percentage at or below which a 'critical' alert is triggered

battery_device_patterns.description: Glob-style patterns to identify battery devices (e.g., BAT0, BAT1). Leave empty to auto-detect all.

items.description: Device name pattern (supports wildcards like * and ?)

excluded_devices.description: List of exact battery device names to ignore (e.g., BAT1 for secondary battery)

items.description: Exact battery device name to exclude

notification_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the notification script before timing out

smtp_server.description: SMTP server hostname (used only if email alerts enabled)

smtp_user.description: SMTP username (leave blank for unauthenticated SMTP)

smtp_password.description: SMTP password (leave blank if no authentication)

smtp_use_tls.description: Use TLS encryption for SMTP connection

webhooks.description: List of webhook endpoints to call on battery status changes

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for webhook response
